chapters.title: The Opening
englishHead: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

english.text: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,
Owner of the Day of Judgment,
Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.
The path of those whom Thou hast favoured;
Not (the path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.

arabic.text: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

chapters.title: The Unity
englishHead: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

english.text: Say: He is Allah, the One!
Allah, the eternally Besought of all!
He begetteth not nor was begotten.
And there is none comparable unto Him.

arabic.text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
